value.title: Monday Follow-Up Relay
value.plan: Add a small staff-approved follow-up queue around the existing appointment-request form so unanswered requests return to the front desk at the next useful moment.

why_fits.text: The practice already accepts appointment requests online and keeps a later Monday window, so the smallest useful change is a follow-up relay around that familiar routine.

value.what_gets_better: Requests are less likely to sit between the website and the front desk, while staff keep control of every patient conversation.

before_after.before: A request enters the current form and staff remember to revisit it between other work.
before_after.after: The same request enters the same form and appears in a short staff-approved follow-up queue.

authority: Front-desk staff decide when and how to contact a requester
steps: Staff confirm appointments in the current calendar

value.invitation: Hearn Systems can map the smallest version of this Spark around the existing form and show exactly how the relay would work.
